notes.title: Frog Detective Language Update
notes.notes:
Hello frog fans,

I’m very pleased to announce today that Frog Detective is now available in Japanese! We’ve been working hard with 8-4 to make the translation as true to the original as possible so more people worldwide can solve the mystery too. I’m super proud of the work the team has done and though I can’t speak or read the language myself, I saw all the symbols and thought to myself “I bet that would be funny if I could understand it!”. Luckily for me the game is also available in English which I understand pretty well. Whichever language you choose to play in, I hope you enjoy our silly little series and maybe even figure out whether crime is real!

All the best,
Grace Bruxner

notes.title: Assorted Frog Detective News
notes.notes:
Hello……..
It has been a while….. It’s because we forgot about the Steam news feature……
But here we are again……

Okay, here is an update for you! 

No, it’s not another game. You can leave angry comments all you want, I’ve taught myself how to not read so it won't be an issue for me. If you have been following along on social media or perhaps any major news outlet, you would know that we have released the game on consoles. However because this is Steam we must respect that we should not be advertising the game on other platforms. So, for this reason, I must insist that you do NOT [url=https://frogdetective.net/]purchase the game[/url] on any of the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/frog-detective-the-entire-mystery-switch/]three[/url] [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10004552]popular[/url] [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-au/games/store/frog-detective-the-entire-mystery/9n0m3gvb0knn]consoles[/url] that we have released it on. DON’T!!! Guys seriously… Seriously I’m not even joking dude… It’s not funny, put your credit card down.

That’s news #1. Second news… Related to the first news… Is that we have a physical edition of Frog Detective: The Entire Mystery coming out! You can [url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/frog-detective]pre-order on Fangamer here[/url]. But again I must insist that you IMMEDIATELY throw away the cartridge if this Steam post has inspired you to purchase it. And then buy it again on Steam for good measure. Just to be safe, you get it. Fangamer also has nice things like shirts and plushies if that’s your thing. 

[url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/frog-detective][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33778951/0b40a787e83401a8e2b5553015183a01657ad5a1.png[/img][/url]

Third news, relating to physical items available for purchase. Dan Golding’s amazing soundtrack is [url=https://www.iam8bit.com/products/frog-detective-vinyl-soundtrack]coming to Vinyl[/url]! You can put it in your ears, your record player, your fridge, do whatever you want within local laws. It’s a really pretty green vinyl with a nice cover made by artist [url=https://www.natalie-andrewson.com/]Natalie Andrewson[/url]. So if you’re into beautiful tunes this one's for you.

[url=https://www.iam8bit.com/products/frog-detective-vinyl-soundtrack][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33778951/3d37a5bf311cd69af3f8a44d0eb30babedae9506.png[/img][/url]

As far as announcements about any games we’re working on etc, Grace (me) is taking a big break from everything and enjoying living in a post-frog detective world. Tom is working on his own projects and helping out with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685740/Surf_Club/]Olivia Haines’ Surf Club[/url], which looks incredible. I simply cannot wait! Thanks as always for your unbelievable support on our silly little game, you have changed our lives immensely. 

Much love, 

Grace xoxo

notes.title: Game devs and players continue banding together to help the Australian bushfire crisis
notes.notes:
Australia is still burning, but over the last couple of days they’ve actually had some rain! While this is a big help to certain areas, there are still 83 fires blazing around the country, and there’s a lot of people and wildlife still in trouble. It’s good job then that there are even more game devs, companies, and communities banding together to help out our friends down under.

A new Humble Bundle, a donation from the makers of Warframe, and a charity initiative run by Eve Online players are just three more ways the games industry is raising money, and you can get involved to show your support too.

notes.title: Frog Detective 2 is out!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33778951/179c8e83fdda63332673924a2b2e079dd6703964.gif[/img]

Oh my gosh!!! Hi everybody!!!

We have been working so hard all year to finish this silly game, and it's out now. It's a bit longer than the first one (but not by too much!) and has a lot of surprises that I think you will enjoy. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047220/Frog_Detective_2_The_Case_of_the_Invisible_Wizard/

We made the first game with literally 0 budget and now that we've got SUPERHOT on board we've had so much more time and freedom to create something we're 100% proud of.  It's always very scary releasing a new game, but doubly so when it's a sequel to something that was received so well already. I appreciate the community that has sprung up around this series and I feel like so much of my anxiety releasing this has just been because I want you to enjoy it as much as the first game. I think/hope you will.  It's so silly!!!

HUGE thanks to my partner in crime Thomas Bowker who is responsible for so much of this game. There's a reason the title doesn't say Grace Bruxner anymore! I really truly see this as both of ours, as Tom is just as invested in the world of Frog Detective as me. He's an amazing designer, tech artist, and programmer. This game 100% would not exist without him. Thank you Tom!!!

Also a HUGE thanks to Dan Golding, who Tom and I have agreed is the most talented member of worm club. You'll understand what we mean when you hear the game. It's beautiful and way too high quality for this game but I wouldn't have it any other way. Dan joined Frog Detective when all I had to show was a waving monkey on an island. Thanks for believing in us, Dan. We'll obviously be devastated when you leave the project to work on the next Star Wars score, but it's inevitable and we've made our peace with it. 

That's all from me. 

:~)

- Grace

notes.title: VERYCOOL update + SUPERHOT news!
notes.notes:
Hello Frog Friends!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33778951/34b2319487e96cce8940bf41cf194f9ef2f23fa1.gif[/img]

I have some exciting news to share! We've just updated the game with some juicy new UI and performance improvements. I have also changed something [i]very important[/i]... Let me know if you spot it! Something is [i]significantly different[/i]... Hehehehehe...

Anyway, enough of that nonsense. The exciting thing I've been wanting to tell you is that we've signed with the company SUPERHOT!!! They make the game called, well, SUPERHOT! They've just started offering funding and support for tiny indies like me, and Frog Detective was the first game to be signed to their new label, how cool is that??

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33778951/c504378e4a90ea73f5f3b23dd9551a594e5bf52c.png[/img]

Tom and I have been holding onto this news for months now and we're so excited to finally share it with you. This means we have money to make more Frog Detective games and focus on them full time! The Haunted Island was made while I was juggling university and working part-time at the wonderful studio League of Geeks. In April, I left to focus on Frog Detective, and formed a studio called [i]WORM CLUB[/i]!! That's when SUPERHOT approached us and asked if we would be interested in working with them. 

[b]So what does this mean for the games? Are there guns in Frog Detective now?![/b]

Nope! SUPERHOT is simply giving us funding and advice and helping us with any connections we need to do exciting things with the series. They've been so generous with their time so far, and I am so, so grateful for it. The games will still be silly and weird like the first one, but since we have more time to dedicate to making them, we'll have time to make them as perfectly as we want to. We're not dealing with any publisher-imposed deadlines or creative overhauls-- we're doing exactly what we did before, but this time we can order food delivery and worry less about our bank accounts! I hope this clears up any questions you may have, but if you're confused or want to know more, please ask in the comments of this post or in the forums! Tom and I are here to answer any questions.

Lots of love,
Grace Bruxner xoxoxox

notes.title: Itch's big summer sale opens with an essential indie bundle
notes.notes:
E3 is over, and we’ve got all that mega-budget fluff out of our system, so let’s get weird again. There’s a big summer sale on over on Itch, which has rapidly become my favourite games store. While the bulk of the discounts run until July 1st, there’s also the Itch.io Summer Selects Bundle available for one week only. It contains six hand-picked games for $9, which, all but one, I can vouch for the excellence of. While SUPERHOT may be the headliner, it also includes low-fi unsettler Paratopic and anti-fascist gay disaster road trip adventure EXTREME MEATPUNKS FOREVER, which has to be written in all caps. notes.title: The Case of the Invisible Wizard is a forthcoming frog detective adventure
notes.notes:
The Haunted Island: A Frog Detective Adventure was a short and adorable experience that made our list of underrated games from 2018. It was all about talking to animal people and solving simple puzzles while chilling to piano tunes and generally having a nice time. Now its creator, indie dev Grace Bruxner, has announced a sequel. Frog Detective 2: The Case of the Invisible Wizard, will be out later this year. 

The trailer makes it look like a similar balance of whimsy and gentle spookiness only this time there's a lion, a zebra, and a rhino among the animals in the mix. It seems like the gloriously pointless magnifying glass will make a comeback, and I'm holding out for a cameo from Lobster Cop, the off-camera legend from the first game.

notes.title: Frog Detective returns to croak (to crack) The Case Of The Invisible Wizard
notes.notes:
Having solved the mystery of The Haunted Island, Grace Bruxner’s ace amphibious sleuth will return later this year. Bruxner has announced Frog Detective 2: The Case Of The Invisible Wizard, a spooky new case for our frogfriend to investigate in Warlock Woods. I adore her funny, friendly, and offbeat style (do check out The Fish Market and Alien Caseno for a free introduction) and am glad to see more of this frog.

notes.title: Thank you!!!!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nj6EYlR.gif[/img]


The game has been out for over a day now and I just wanna say a huge thank you for all of the kind posts, reviews, messages and art that have come out in the last 24 hours. It's a great thing that a short and silly game like mine can safely have a home on Steam amongst larger and more complicated games. 

Developing this game has been wonderful and I would like to acknowledge the hard work of Thomas Bowker who did the programming and tools development as well as the outline shader that has been super popular. Tom is an extremely good egg and deserves a bunch of credit. I would also like to thank Dan Golding for creating an iconic and catchy soundtrack. Every time I got a track from Dan I lost my dang mind!! He's a genius!! 

I'm super excited to start work on the second game in the series. I hope I can get it to you very soon. :-)

Thanks again!!!!

Grace Bruxner
